title: Paper: Great Pyramid concentrates electric fields around the King's Chamber

tellings.quote: there was a paper that came out a while back that talked about the [clears throat] capability of the great pyramid to store and concentrate electric fields directly around the king's chamber.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who studies the Egyptian pyramids, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a scientific paper that came out a while back. He says it described how the Great Pyramid of Giza can store and concentrate electric fields right around the King's Chamber, a room deep inside it. Drumm tells it because, if true, it would support his idea that the pyramid was built as a kind of machine.
